condition: Proceed only after exact one-deviation Q_R75 headroom passes; stage0 N8000 is interface evidence, not corner-performance validation.
proposed_features: 65 = current candidate causal32 + same-state actual R75 candidate causal32 + is_R75 flag; no case/seed/N/future/teacher cost input
baseline: Frozen R75 cab5cae4931722cdbe61080afcc758503964dcdf71c3a6738fcb0372f6441458, maintained through one proposal plus actual-action commit every real callback
proposed_target: (G_candidate - G_R75) / (M * (W + R)); G=write_bytes*R+read_bytes*W+misses*penalty*W*R; W/R are bandwidths. R75 candidate target is exactly zero.
interpretation: One deviation followed by real R75, not optimal Q and not the learned policy's repeated-intervention cost.
fallback: R75 remains a candidate and executes normally when no alternative is selected; a negative predicted advantage is not a performance guarantee.
runtime_budget_direction: Use a predeclared cheap visible-event eligibility rule before computing network features, e.g. at most one network event per 512 new public probes; exact rate/threshold must be frozen before calibration. Training states must use the same eligibility rule.
calibration_boundary: Threshold and model selection only within training/calibration seeds. Do not tune on stage0 dev and then call it unseen validation.
future_evidence: New >=100k scale batch and distinct-seed validation before claiming corner advantage over R75. Include ordinary controls, every regression, false override loss, IO+miss separately from D.
features_hpp_status: Uncompiled new-experiment glue, not deployed. Requires selected-anchor native/Python pool, execution-order, auxiliary-observer and FP32 parity tests before use.
